errors.error_description: Introduced an inefficient arithmetic chain by multiplying four 8-bit values in a cascaded manner, inferring large combinational multipliers on a single line.
Drove an input port internally using a continuous assignment to the input net.
Assigned a 16-bit register to an 8-bit output without explicit truncation or casting, causing silent data loss.
Created multiple active drivers on a single wire by issuing two continuous assignments to the same internal net.
